primitives.name: Competitive Parity Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The floor is competitor parity — we ship everything competitors have that matters — and the ceiling is differentiation they can't touch (exactness proofs, calibration evidence, glass-box metrics).
primitives.assumptions: All competitor features are enumerable and measurable within a shared feature space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When feature overlap exceeds threshold T, trigger parity implementation.

layer2.mapping: Maps competitor feature sets to GSE's internal feature representation via schema alignment and entity deduplication.
layer2.telemetry: Number of parity features implemented vs total competitor features.

primitives.name: Calibration Evidence Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: The floor is competitor parity — we ship everything competitors have that matters — and the ceiling is differentiation they can't touch (exactness proofs, calibration evidence, glass-box metrics).
primitives.assumptions: Glass-box metrics must be empirically verifiable and transparent to end users.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When model confidence intervals exceed tolerance, initiate recalibration.

layer2.mapping: Derives probabilistic accuracy bounds from observed outcomes and predicted distributions.
layer2.telemetry: Mean absolute error and coverage probability of predictive intervals.

primitives.name: Structured Data Schema Profiler
primitives.verbatim_quote: For each file: profile its schema, aggregate every entity programmatically (never eyeball large files), write a deep analytical dossier, land it in the intel repo, commit, and push.
primitives.assumptions: Each data file contains structured entities with consistent semantic meaning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When entity count exceeds memory capacity, apply streaming aggregation.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw JSON structures to normalized relational tables using schema profiling and counter-based entity enumeration.
layer2.telemetry: Total unique entities processed per file, average schema depth.

Entity_aggregation provides the foundational data infrastructure necessary for both. These operators interact through a feedback loop: entity aggregation feeds into floor_paritization to identify missing features, which then informs glass_box_metric development to validate those features' effectiveness. Failure modes include schema misalignment leading to incomplete parity, or insufficient aggregation causing blind spots in competitive coverage. The system's robustness depends on iterative refinement of these mappings against empirical data.
